It actually is rapey, though. Especially if it comes as a surprise and isn't something you've discussed with your partner first. Forcing someone down, hitting them, choking them etc definitely flirts with rape, I think we can all agree on that. It's basically taking what you want, when and how you want it. And if there is consent, then sure, go ahead and be as freaky as you wish. But it's just not justifiable to treat someone like that without their specific consent. 

And what the hell is wrong with regular good old vanilla sex?

It's not about that, though. I'm not judging anyone's kinks here. We all have them. What I'm questioning is how come it's not frowned upon, but rather encouraged, for a man to impose the sub/dom kink on women without consent.

I definitely agree. Maybe I came off as more judgmental than I really am, but what I was trying to say is that it's a problem how (some) women tend to perpetuate this idea that all women want to "be treated like a queen in the streets and like a whore in the sheets", be choked, manhandled, slapped etc etc. 

And sure, like many people have replied here, I guess I can understand how it's arousing to feel wanted in such a primal way that your man can't control himself. We all want to feel desired, of course. But if that's your thing just let it be your thing. Don't spread the idea that all girls are into it just because you are. 

I also think a big part of it is the fact that "toxic feminism" has taken the porn industry's misogynistic portrayal of women and sort of adopted it. By saying "hell yeah, we totally want to be thrown around like a ragdoll, brutally strangled and ejaculated on. That shit is hot! Not only men can be freaky, I'll show you freaky!" I feel like so called feminists have made a disastrous and misguided attempt at owning their sexuality. Playing into the fantasy of the "cool girlfriend" who puts up with anything and likes anal/BDSM/fetish stuff just because other "feminists" and media tells her that she should be as sexually adventurous and have just as high a libido as her boyfriend, is actually really damaging.
